description_en: Retrieves the list of alert groups
name: ListAlertAggregations

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center is located. Specify the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: The assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: The assets are located outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the query view
parameters.name: query_view_id

parameters.help_en:
The query filter condition in JSON format. Valid values:

`{"Type":"maxCost", "Value":"100"}`: The 100 queries with the longest execution duration.
`{"Type":"status","Value":"finished"}`: Completed queries.
`{"Type":"status","Value":"running"}`: Running queries.
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"30","Max":"50"}`: Custom execution duration queries. You can set the minimum and maximum execution duration. Min specifies the minimum execution duration. Max specifies the maximum execution duration. Unit: milliseconds (ms).
    - If only Min is set, queries with an execution duration greater than this value are returned.
    - If only Max is set, queries with an execution duration less than this value are returned.
    - If both Min and Max are set, queries with an execution duration greater than or equal to Min and less than or equal to Max are returned
parameters.help_zh:
查询过滤条件，JSON格式，取值如下：

`{"Type":"maxCost", "Value":"100"}`：耗时最长的100个查询。
`{"Type":"status","Value":"finished"}`：已完成的查询。
`{"Type":"status","Value":"running"}`：运行中的查询。
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"30","Max":"50"}`：自定义耗时查询，您可以自定义设置查询的最短耗时和最长耗时，Min表示最短耗时；Max表示最长耗时，单位为毫秒（ms）。
    - 仅设置Min表示查询执行耗时大于该值的查询。
    - 仅设置Max表示查询执行耗时小于该值的查询。
    - 设置Min和Max表示查询耗时大于等于Min的值且小于等于Max的值的查询
parameters.name: query_condition

parameters.help_en: The time when the alert first occurred
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the alert
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页参数：每页显示条数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: The view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request
parameters.help_zh: MaxResults本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query. Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no more results exist. If a next page exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

AlertAggregations.description_en: The list of alert groups returned based on the specified aggregation method, sorted by alert count in descending order
AlertAggregations.description_zh: 按指定聚合方式返回的告警分组列表，按告警数量从高到低排序

AccountDisplayValues.description_en: The list of account display values associated with the aggregation group, in one-to-one correspondence with AccountIds. When the username is valid and differs from the account ID, the format is "username/account ID". Otherwise, only the account ID is returned
AccountDisplayValues.description_zh: 聚合分组涉及的账号展示值列表，与 AccountIds 顺序一一对应。用户名有效且与账号 ID 不同时，格式为“用户名/账号ID”；否则仅返回账号 ID

items.description_en: The display value of a single account. When the username is valid and differs from the account ID, the format is "username/account ID". Otherwise, only the account ID is returned
items.description_zh: 单个账号的展示值。用户名有效且与账号 ID 不同时，格式为“用户名/账号ID”；否则仅返回账号 ID

AccountIds.description_en: The list of member accounts IDs for which the report is generated. You need to specify this parameter only when you generate a multi-account report and want to limit the report to specific member accounts
AccountIds.description_zh:
生成报告的成员账号ID列表。
说明：仅在您生成多账号报告时，且希望生成指定账号范围的报告，才需要传入该参数

items.description_en: The list of member accounts IDs for which the report is generated. You need to specify this parameter only when you generate a multi-account report and want to limit the report to specific member accounts
items.description_zh:
生成报告的成员账号ID列表。
说明：仅在您生成多账号报告时，且希望生成指定账号范围的报告，才需要传入该参数

AggregationKey.description_en: The unique identifier of the aggregation group, which is a concatenation of AggregationType, PrimaryValue, and SecondaryValue joined by colons (:). The last segment is empty if no secondary aggregation value exists
AggregationKey.description_zh: 聚合分组的唯一标识，由 AggregationType、PrimaryValue 和 SecondaryValue 使用英文冒号（:）拼接；无二级聚合值时最后一段为空

AlertCount.description_en: The number of consecutive failures. This parameter is optional

AttackStages.description_en: The collection of MITRE ATT&CK attack techniques associated with alerts in the aggregation group. Each element is a JSON array string
AttackStages.description_zh: 聚合分组内告警关联的 MITRE ATT&CK 攻击技术集合。每个元素为一个 JSON 数组字符串

items.description_en: The normalized MITRE ATT&CK attack technique information represented as a JSON array string. The array object contains techniqueId and techniqueName
items.description_zh: 单条归一化的 MITRE ATT&CK 攻击技术信息，使用 JSON 数组字符串表示；数组对象包含 techniqueId 和 techniqueName

DefenseActionCounts.description_en: The quantity distribution by defense action within the aggregation group. Name is the action field value, and Value is the corresponding alert count
DefenseActionCounts.description_zh: 聚合分组内按防御动作统计的数量分布。Name 为 action 字段值，Value 为对应的告警数量

Name.description_en: The display name of the entity attribute field that can be added to the whitelist
Name.description_zh: 可以加白的实体属性字段展示名

Value.description_en: The default right-hand value displayed for the whitelist rule
Value.description_zh: 加白规则默认展示的右值

FirstTime.description_en: The time of the first access, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
FirstTime.description_zh: 首次访问时间。使用秒级Unix时间戳表示

LatestTime.description_en: The most recent time when the attack event occurred
LatestTime.description_zh: 攻击事件最近一次发生时间

PrimaryDisplayValue.description_en: The display text of the primary aggregation value. For account aggregation, the format is "username/account ID". If no valid username exists, only the account ID is returned. For event summaries, the event name is returned based on the Lang parameter. If the name is missing, the event UUID is returned
PrimaryDisplayValue.description_zh: 聚合主值的展示文案。账号聚合时返回“用户名/账号ID”，无有效用户名时仅返回账号 ID；事件聚合时按 Lang 返回事件名称，名称缺失时返回事件 UUID

PrimaryValue.description_en: The value corresponding to the primary query condition
PrimaryValue.description_zh: 一级查询条件对应的value值

SecondaryValue.description_en: The value corresponding to the secondary query condition
SecondaryValue.description_zh: 二级查询条件对应的value值

Example: [\\"MRM\\"]
SourceCodes.description_zh:

示例：[\\"MRM\\"]

StatusCounts.description_en: The quantity distribution by alert status within the aggregation group. Name is the alert status value, and Value is the corresponding alert count
StatusCounts.description_zh: 聚合分组内按告警状态统计的数量分布。Name 为告警状态值，Value 为对应的告警数量
